title: Awesome FastAPI
tagline: A curated list of awesome things related to FastAPI.
intro: [FastAPI](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/) is a modern, high-performance, batteries-included Python web framework that's perfect for building RESTful APIs.

items.name: FastAPI Admin
items.desc: Functional admin panel that provides a user interface for performing CRUD operations on your data. Currently only works with the Tortoise ORM.

items.name: FastAPI Amis Admin
items.desc: A high-performance, efficient and easily extensible FastAPI admin framework.

items.name: Piccolo Admin
items.desc: A powerful and modern admin GUI, using the Piccolo ORM.

items.name: SQLAlchemy Admin
items.desc: Admin Panel for FastAPI/Starlette that works with SQLAlchemy models.

items.name: Starlette Admin
items.desc: Admin framework for FastAPI/Starlette, supporting SQLAlchemy, SQLModel, MongoDB, and ODMantic.

items.name: AuthX
items.desc: Customizable Authentications and Oauth2 management for FastAPI.

items.name: FastAPI Auth
items.desc: Pluggable auth that supports the OAuth2 Password Flow with JWT access and refresh tokens.

items.name: FastAPI Azure Auth
items.desc: Azure AD authentication for your APIs with single and multi tenant support.

items.name: FastAPI Casbin Auth
items.desc: Authorization which supports various access control models like RBAC, ReBAC and ABAC through Casbin.

items.name: FastAPI Cloud Auth
items.desc: Simple integration between FastAPI and cloud authentication services (AWS Cognito, Auth0, Firebase Authentication).

items.name: FastAPI JWT Auth
items.desc: JWT auth (based on [Flask-JWT-Extended](https://github.com/vimalloc/flask-jwt-extended)).

items.name: FastAPI Login
items.desc: Account management and authentication (based on [Flask-Login](https://github.com/maxcountryman/flask-login)).

items.name: FastAPI Permissions
items.desc: Row-level permissions.

items.name: FastAPI Security
items.desc: Implements authentication and authorization as dependencies in FastAPI.

items.name: FastAPI Simple Security
items.desc: Out-of-the-box API key security manageable through path operations.

items.name: FastAPI Users
items.desc: Account management, authentication, authorization.

items.name: FastAPI Zitadel Auth
items.desc: OAuth2 using the IAM platform [Zitadel](https://github.com/zitadel/zitadel).

items.name: FastAPI Guard
items.desc: Rate Limiting, Automatically Ban IPs, Penetration Attack Detection, Whitelist/blacklist (countries, IPs, Cloud Providers), User Agent Filtering, Geolocation, Redis integration for persistence, and more.

items.name: secure
items.desc: Define and apply HTTP security headers consistently in FastAPI apps using ASGI middleware and a single configuration object.

items.name: Edgy ORM
items.desc: Complex databases made simple.

items.name: FastAPI SQLAlchemy
items.desc: Simple integration between FastAPI and [SQLAlchemy](https://www.sqlalchemy.org/).

items.name: Fastapi-SQLA
items.desc: SQLAlchemy extension for FastAPI with support for pagination, asyncio, and pytest.

items.name: FastAPIwee
items.desc: A simple way to create REST API based on [PeeWee](https://github.com/coleifer/peewee) models.

items.name: FastSQLA
items.desc: Async SQLAlchemy 2.0+ extension for FastAPI with SQLModel support, built-in pagination & more.

items.name: GINO
items.desc: A lightweight asynchronous ORM built on top of SQLAlchemy core for Python asyncio.

items.name: ORM
items.desc: An async ORM.

items.name: ormar
items.desc: Ormar is an async ORM that uses Pydantic validation and can be used directly in FastAPI requests and responses so you are left with only one set of models to maintain. Alembic migrations included.

items.name: Piccolo
items.desc: An async ORM and query builder, supporting Postgres and SQLite, with batteries (migrations, security, etc).

items.name: Saffier ORM
items.desc: The only Python ORM you will ever need.

items.name: SQLModel
items.desc: SQLModel (which is powered by Pydantic and SQLAlchemy) is a library for interacting with SQL databases from Python code, with Python objects.

items.name: Tortoise ORM
items.desc: An easy-to-use asyncio ORM (Object Relational Mapper) inspired by Django.

children.name: FastAPI Example
children.desc: An example of the Tortoise-ORM FastAPI integration.

children.name: Tutorial: Setting up Tortoise ORM with FastAPI

items.name: asyncpgsa
items.desc: A wrapper around [asyncpg](https://github.com/MagicStack/asyncpg) for use with [SQLAlchemy Core](https://docs.sqlalchemy.org/en/latest/core/).

items.name: Databases
items.desc: Async SQL query builder that works on top of the [SQLAlchemy Core](https://docs.sqlalchemy.org/en/latest/core/) expression language.

items.name: PyPika
items.desc: A SQL query builder that exposes the full richness of the SQL language.

items.name: Beanie
items.desc: Asynchronous Python ODM for MongoDB, based on [Motor](https://motor.readthedocs.io/en/stable/) and [Pydantic](https://pydantic.dev/docs/), which supports data and schema migrations out of the box.

items.name: MongoEngine
items.desc: A Document-Object Mapper (think ORM, but for document databases) for working with MongoDB from Python.

items.name: Motor
items.desc: Asynchronous Python driver for MongoDB.

items.name: ODMantic
items.desc: AsyncIO MongoDB ODM integrated with [Pydantic](https://pydantic.dev/docs/).

items.name: PynamoDB
items.desc: A pythonic interface to Amazon's DynamoDB.

items.name: FastAPI-CamelCase
items.desc: CamelCase JSON support for FastAPI utilizing [Pydantic](https://pydantic.dev/docs/).

children.name: CamelCase Models with FastAPI and Pydantic
children.desc: Accompanying blog post from the author of the extension.

items.name: Pydantic-SQLAlchemy
items.desc: Convert SQLAlchemy models to [Pydantic](https://pydantic.dev/docs/) models.

items.name: Dishka
items.desc: Dependency injection framework with scopes, finalization, and modular providers, with a built-in FastAPI integration.

items.name: modern-di
items.desc: Dependency injection framework with IoC container and scopes, with a [FastAPI integration](https://github.com/modern-python/modern-di-fastapi).

items.name: Wireup
items.desc: Inject dependencies with zero runtime overhead in FastAPI; Share dependencies across web, cli or other interfaces.

items.name: FastAPI Code Generator

items.name: FastAPI Client Generator
items.desc: Generate a mypy- and IDE-friendly API client from an OpenAPI spec.

items.name: FastAPI-MCP
items.desc: Expose FastAPI endpoints as Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools, preserving schemas and docs, with built-in OAuth 2.1 auth support.

items.name: FastAPI MVC
items.desc: Developer productivity tool for making high-quality FastAPI production-ready APIs.

items.name: FastAPI Profiler
items.desc: A FastAPI Middleware of joerick/pyinstrument to check your service performance.
